prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app homepage comp for TravelCanvas
Primary request: Create a polished 1440×1000 first-viewport UI mockup that lets users begin planning a trip as quickly as possible. This is a real product interface, not a poster. Use the supplied TravelCanvas screenshot only as a reference for palette, typography character, restrained paper-like component style, and overall brand character; do not copy its layout or content.
Scene/backdrop: Full desktop web application canvas in warm sand #f6f4ee, with generous but efficient margins and a subtle editorial paper-page depth.
Composition/framing: Straight-on full-page desktop screenshot, 1440×1000 aspect ratio, no browser chrome, no conventional top navigation. A compact brand lockup “TRAVELCANVAS / 中国旅行规划” sits at the upper left. Beneath it, a concise headline reads exactly “把整趟旅行，顺着一条线安排好”. The main content is centered and organized as one clear vertical three-stage journey rail. The rail should feel like a route line with numbered nodes, not a dashboard sidebar.
Stage 01: Expanded active section titled exactly “01 旅行需求”. Show a compact two-row form with clean, realistic controls. Include these exact values/labels: “目的地” with “杭州”, “出发日期” with “2026/09/18”, “旅行天数” with “2 天”, “出行人数” with “2 人”. Add one optional compact preference field reading “偏好：人文街巷 · 本地美食”. The primary button reads exactly “开始发现”. Make the action visually immediate and dominant.
Stage 02: Collapsed preview section titled exactly “02 选择想去的地方”. Show a compact summary row with three small thumbnail cards, using elegant abstract place illustrations or neutral color-block placeholders rather than real photographs. Card names may be exactly “西湖”, “中国茶叶博物馆”, “河坊街”. Include a small summary such as “3 个候选 · 可随时调整”. Do not show ratings, reviews, prices, or invented claims.
Stage 03: Collapsed preview section titled exactly “03 生成逐日路线”. Show a restrained mini route-map preview made of a simple line and pins plus a small budget summary “预算待确认”. Include “完成后生成每日路线”. It must read as a future preview, not finished live data.
Journey behavior cue: Communicate visually that a completed stage will compress into a concise summary while the active stage expands. Stage 01 is open; stages 02 and 03 are folded but visibly preview their next content.
Secondary trust note: On the right, place one small, calm verification note reading exactly “数据由高德 / 天气 / 公开攻略校验” and “来源与查询时间会随结果显示”. This should not resemble a KPI panel or enterprise dashboard.
Style/medium: High-fidelity contemporary Chinese travel planning product UI. Precise, efficient, professional, with subtle lift, soft paper layers, crisp alignment, clear labels, and refined typography. Desktop product mockup quality suitable for direct visual design decision-making.
Color palette: Tea-mountain green #226054 for primary controls and route nodes; pottery orange #df7255 for restrained accents and active numbering; warm sand #f6f4ee background; rice paper #fffdf8 surfaces; pine ink #18322e for primary text. Use only subtle tonal tints derived from these colors.
Typography: Elegant Chinese editorial display treatment for the headline, paired with a highly legible modern sans-serif for controls and body copy. Preserve exact Chinese text and strong hierarchy.
Materials/textures: Very subtle warm paper grain, fine 1px borders, restrained soft shadows only on the expanded active stage and selected/raised elements. Rounded corners 12–16px, compact spacing system.
Constraints: Keep all important interface content within the 1440×1000 first viewport. Prioritize immediate trip-start action and scannable progression. Use no real photos. Use no fabricated ratings, reviews, hotel prices, ticket prices, inventory, or unverified travel facts. No conventional navigation bar. No KPI cards, charts, data tables, admin sidebar, analytics widgets, or enterprise dashboard composition.
Avoid: corporate dashboard aesthetics, excessive decoration, Xiaohongshu poster style, purple or blue gradients, glassmorphism, neon glow, giant marketing hero art, generic AI sparkle symbols, floating pill clutter, unrealistic tiny text, text errors, duplicated controls, watermarks.
